title: Irish standardised school breaks 2014/15-2025/26, primary and post-primary, extracted from the four DoE standardisation circulars
licence: Irish public sector information. Circulars supplied manually by the user because assets.gov.ie, gov.ie and circulars.gov.ie all return HTTP 403 to programmatic fetch and UA spoofing is forbidden.
intended_use: Phase 2: per-year school-term tables replacing SCHOOL_TERMS_2022.
coverage: 12 school years, 2014/15 to 2025/26. 2026/27 deliberately NOT extracted - the replay ends 2026-09-30.
rows: 84 total: 60 circular-dated (October mid-term, Christmas, February mid-term x2 sectors, Easter) + 24 rule-derived summer rows.
primary_vs_post_primary: The February mid-term differs by sector and is captured separately: primary closes the Thursday and Friday only (2 statutory days, extendable to 5 using 3 discretionary days), post-primary closes the full week.
summer_is_a_RULE_not_a_date: Summer is not standardised by the circulars. Reopen uses the rule stated verbatim in all four: 'the school year will normally commence during the week in which 1st September falls' (0072/2022 adds that it may commence the week prior); the Monday of that week is used. Closing uses the published rule - primary end of June, post-primary end of May. These rows are marked circular='RULE (not a circular date)' and page='n/a'.
verification: 2014/15 parsed rows were checked line-by-line against the circular's own Appendix A text: October 27-31 Oct 2014; Christmas close 19 Dec 2014 reopen 5 Jan 2015; February primary 19-20 Feb 2015, post-primary 16-20 Feb 2015; Easter close 27 Mar 2015 reopen 13 Apr 2015. All five MATCH. All 60 circular-dated rows passed a month-plausibility check with 0 failures.
